title: Homogeneous quotient action and coefficient projections (first)
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion, L invertible, J=j.ker with J²=0, and n≥0 [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-invertible-module, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Fix a TensorGradedPresentation T [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation] and the canonical comparison data D=(a_r,k_r) [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Set F=j^*(J⊗L^n), N=(j^*L)^n, H=H¹(Z,-) [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Fix e≥0, f:O_Z→N and x:O_Z→N^(e+1). Define s=c(f^⊗1), t=c(x), and Q_r=k_r^(-1)∘H¹(X,π_(n(r+1)),1), using the explicit homogeneous sections and degree projections [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection]. Suppose σ is a local quotient action on K satisfying i(σ(p(b))y)=b i(y) and commuting with restrictions, μ is its global endomorphism action, and ρ(g)=H¹(X,μ(g)). Then for every z∈H¹(X,K), Q_(e+1)(ρ(s)z)=H(mulTensorPowSection f F e 1)(Q_e(z)). This statement asserts only action compatibility, with no section boundary, resolution, or derivation identity.

proof.text: Use the sheaf-level homogeneous action square, whose transported kernel map is constructed explicitly from coefficient sheaf isomorphisms. Apply the module cohomology functor and evaluate the map-composition equality.

Prove naturality of the affine cohomology edge from source and target naturality of moduleCohomologyFMap. Unfold the canonical coefficient comparison and use this square to identify edge followed by coefficient comparison with H¹ of the coefficient sheaf isomorphism. A generic isomorphism-cancellation lemma transports naturality of any coefficient morphism. Use hD to obtain the square for D.k, use haction to replace ρ by H¹(μ), and apply the explicit coefficient projection evaluation formula and a generic additive-equivalence cancellation lemma.

theorem tensorGradedAction_projection_first {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (n : ℕ) (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L) (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D)
    (e : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n)
    (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ (((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n).tensorPow (e + 1))
    (σ : ∀ U : X.Opens, T.C.right.obj.obj (op U) →+*
      Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op U)) (T.I.val.obj (op U)))
    (μ : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+* End T.I)
    (ρ : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+*
      Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj T.I))
    (hlocal : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (b : T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U))
        (T.i.val.app (op U) (σ U (T.p.right.hom.app (op U) b) y)) =
        b * @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (T.i.val.app (op U) y))
    (hrestrict : ∀ (U V : X.Opens) (a : V ⟶ U)
      (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      T.I.val.map a.op (σ U g y) = σ V (T.C.right.obj.map a.op g) (T.I.val.map a.op y))
    (hglobal : ∀ (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤)) (U : X.Opens)
      (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      (μ g).val.app (op U) y = σ U (T.C.right.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op g) y)
    (haction : ∀ g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤), ρ g =
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).map (μ g)).hom) :
    let F : Z.Modules := (tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n)
    let N : Z.Modules := ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n
    let H := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Z.toRingedSpace 1
    (∀ z : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj T.I,
      tensorGradedCoefficientProjection T D (e + 1)
        (ρ (tensorGradedSection T D 0 (tensorPowSection f 1)) z) =
      H.map (mulTensorPowSection f F e 1) (tensorGradedCoefficientProjection T D e z))
